TABLE.NAME: bunamrag
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the bunamrag activity module instances (a learning unit).

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: dxfundamental
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the DX Fundamental quiz.

FIELD.NAME: dxenrichment
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the DX Enriquecimiento quiz.

FIELD.NAME: summaryafter
FIELD.COMMENT: none | subtheme | theme | activity. When to show the tracked-interactives results summary to a student.

FIELD.NAME: summarymessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Custom message shown alongside the results summary, always rendered as markdown.

FIELD.NAME: summarymode
FIELD.COMMENT: modal | page. How the results summary is presented.

FIELD.NAME: summarymodalauto
FIELD.COMMENT: When summarymode = modal: intercept the pager's next click at the summary point and show the modal before navigating.

FIELD.NAME: summarypagerinsert
FIELD.COMMENT: When summarymode = page: insert the summary page as an unnumbered stop when advancing past the summary point, instead of only being reachable via the button.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_theme
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the themes (e.g. 1.1, 1.2, 1.3) of a bunamrag unit.

FIELD.NAME: bunamragid
FIELD.COMMENT: The bunamrag instance this theme belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: theme name/number, e.g. 1.1

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_subtheme
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the subthemes (e.g. 1.1.1) of a theme, one row per level (remedial/fundamental/enriquecimiento).

FIELD.NAME: themeid
FIELD.COMMENT: The theme this subtheme belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Subtheme identifier shared across its level variants, e.g. 1.1.1

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: remedial | fundamental | enriquecimiento

FIELD.NAME: dxfslot
FIELD.COMMENT: Question slot in the DX Fundamental quiz that maps to this subtheme. Auto-computed from content order.

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_content
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the content blocks of a subtheme-level.

FIELD.NAME: subthemeid
FIELD.COMMENT: The subtheme-level this content block belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: blocktype
FIELD.COMMENT: textcontent | videourl | interactive | h5p | podcastaudio

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Generic payload: HTML for textcontent, JSON for interactive, URL for external videourl, etc.

FIELD.NAME: contentformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the content field when it is rich text.

FIELD.NAME: transcript
FIELD.COMMENT: Accessible text transcript (always markdown), currently only used by videourl blocks.

FIELD.NAME: interactivetype
FIELD.COMMENT: dialogcards | multiplechoice | fillblanks | dragwords. Only used by interactive blocks.

FIELD.NAME: renderedhtml
FIELD.COMMENT: HTML compiled from content at save time, for interactive blocks. Avoids reprocessing the JSON on every view.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Short label identifying this interactive block in the results summary. Only used by interactive blocks.

FIELD.NAME: trackresults
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this interactive block's attempts/best score are recorded and shown in the results summary. Only meaningful for multiplechoice/fillblanks/dragwords - dialogcards are never tracked.

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_interactive_progress
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user aggregate progress (attempts, best score) on a tracked interactive content block.

FIELD.NAME: contentid
FIELD.COMMENT: The bunamrag_content row (blocktype = interactive, trackresults = 1) this progress is for.

FIELD.NAME: bestscore
FIELD.COMMENT: Best score (0-100) achieved across all attempts.

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_trajectory
TABLE.COMMENT: Caches the personalized level (per subtheme code) resolved for a user the first time they view the content, so it does not need to be recalculated from the DX quizzes on every visit.

FIELD.NAME: level
FIELD.COMMENT: remedial | fundamental | enriquecimiento

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Records every time a user views a subtheme page, so they can resume where they left off.
